refinement.rule: refine up to 18 exact jurisdiction cells; one tile transport failure cannot discard successful cells and is never mislabeled as a scientific null

coverage.densityRule: significant terrain sectors: preferred >=60 => 3 corridors; >=30 => 2; otherwise >=1; exact-cell high-resolution scientific null may explain a lower count
